item.title: Journal Paper
item.description:
Good news! Our paper entitled “Improved Scalable Analytical Model for Predicting the Performance of SPM Machine Considering Magnet Shape and Magnetization Pattern” submitted to IEEE Transactions on IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement. Sometimes I want to complain about the unjustice of the review process, manipulated by some unfriendly researcher. Nevertheless, paper is not life, either is one’s achievement. Let’s face the reality and make it a better place.

Beside, I would like to thank Luca and Bin, who help me a lot in my first step in Sweden, academically and in daily life. I hope that our friendship and collaboration will continue through our path towards a electrified world.

item.title: Journal Paper
item.description: I would appreciate all the co-authers for their contribution in the paper entitled “The Scalable Analytical Model for Calculating the Magnetic Field of Surface Mounted Permanent Magnet Motor”. This paper entitled was submitted to IEEE Transactions on Industrial Electronics on 21-Apr-2023， revised on 09-Aug-2023 and 15-Nov-2023, accepted on 31-Jan-2024.
